key_insight: Claw-Eval is an end-to-end benchmark that evaluates autonomous agents at the trajectory level (not just final outputs), while explicitly testing safety, robustness, and broader modality/interaction coverage using 300 human-verified scenarios.
problem_solved: Existing agent benchmarks miss errors that occur during multi-step execution, under-evaluate safety and robustness, and cover too few modalities or interaction styles—Claw-Eval fills these gaps.
method: Trajectory-aware grading: assess step-by-step agent behaviors and intermediate states rather than only terminal outputs.
Human-verified scenario suite: 300 curated cases spanning diverse tasks, modalities, and interaction paradigms to ensure realistic evaluation.
Explicit safety & robustness probes: targeted tests and metrics for failure modes, adversarial inputs, and environment perturbations.
impact: Provides practitioners a more trustworthy, actionable picture of agent reliability in realistic deployments, guiding model selection, debugging, and safety mitigation. It enables prioritized improvements that reduce real-world failures.
